_about: Fallback and instant lines for scenario 'walk-home'. The Worker uses these when the line model is slow, refuses or returns rubbish, for the opening call-out (so 'begin' answers with no latency) and for the moment of escalation. 'woman' is keyed by the man's stance (woman POV); 'bystander' by situation (bystander POV). Every entry has the line and her matching inner thought; scripts/gen-voice.mjs renders both to public/audio/vo/<id>.mp3 and public/audio/vo/<id>_t.mp3. Crude language is deliberate and bounded: no slurs about race, religion, disability or orientation, no sexual description, no threats of sexual violence, no weapons.

opening.speaker: man
opening.text: Hey. Hey, beautiful. Where you headed?

opening.speaker: man
opening.text: Hey, miss! Lemme talk to you for a second.

opening.speaker: man
opening.text: Damn. You walking home all by yourself?

opening.speaker: man
opening.text: Hey, gorgeous. Smile, it's not that bad.
opening.thought: Keep your head down. Keep moving.

opening.speaker: man
opening.text: Hey! Hey, pretty lady. Where you going so fast?
opening.thought: He's talking to me. Of course he is.

opening.speaker: man
opening.text: Good evening, beautiful. You look good tonight.
opening.thought: Just walk. Don't give him anything.

opening.speaker: man
opening.text: Hey, miss. Miss! Can I walk with you?

persist.speaker: man
persist.text: C'mon, I'm just saying hi. What's your name?

persist.speaker: man
persist.text: You can't even talk to me? One minute, that's all.

persist.speaker: man
persist.text: You got a man? I bet you don't have a man.
persist.thought: Whatever I say, he'll use it.

persist.speaker: man

persist.speaker: man
persist.text: Lemme get your number. Real quick.

persist.speaker: man
persist.text: Where do you live? I'll walk you.
persist.thought: He cannot find out where I live.

persist.speaker: man

persist.thought: If I smile, does he leave?

persist.speaker: man

follow.speaker: man
follow.text: I'm just walking the same way. Relax.

follow.speaker: man

follow.thought: Don't run. Don't let him see you run.

follow.speaker: man
follow.text: You walk fast for somebody so little.

follow.speaker: man
follow.text: I can do this all night, sweetheart.
follow.thought: I can't lead him to my door.

follow.speaker: man
follow.text: Don't be scared. I'm just keeping you company.
follow.thought: The shop. The shop is still open.

follow.speaker: man
follow.text: You gonna make me chase you?

follow.speaker: man
follow.text: Hey, I'm talking to you. Turn around.

block.speaker: man
block.text: Hold up, hold up. One second.

block.speaker: man
block.text: Whoa, slow down. I'm talking to you.

block.speaker: man
block.text: Just one minute. You're not in that much of a hurry.

block.speaker: man

block.speaker: man
block.text: Where you going? I'm not done.
block.thought: The street. Step into the street.

block.speaker: man
block.text: Look at me when I'm talking to you.

block.speaker: man
block.text: Relax. I just want to see that pretty face.

guilt.speaker: man
guilt.text: Damn, why you gotta be like that? I'm just being nice.

guilt.speaker: man
guilt.text: I give you a compliment and you can't even say thank you?
guilt.thought: I don't owe him a thank you.

guilt.speaker: man
guilt.text: See, that's the problem with girls like you. Can't take a compliment.

guilt.speaker: man
guilt.text: I'm trying to be a gentleman and you're acting all rude.
guilt.thought: He thinks I'm the rude one.

guilt.speaker: man
guilt.text: All I said was hi. Why you treating me like a criminal?
guilt.thought: Because you won't leave me alone.

guilt.speaker: man
guilt.text: You could at least be polite. Somebody raised you better.
guilt.thought: Stay calm. Don't set him off.

guilt.speaker: man
guilt.text: It's a compliment, sweetheart. Most girls would say thank you.
guilt.thought: Just let it go. Please let it go.

hostile.speaker: man
hostile.text: Stuck-up bitch. You think you're too good for me?

hostile.speaker: man
hostile.text: You're not even that cute. Don't flatter yourself.

hostile.speaker: man
hostile.text: Fuck you, then. Nobody wants you anyway.

hostile.speaker: man
hostile.text: Bitch, I was being nice to you.

hostile.speaker: man
hostile.text: Who the hell you think you are?
hostile.thought: Don't make it worse. Just go.

hostile.speaker: man

intimidate.speaker: man
intimidate.text: Who you think you're talking to?

intimidate.speaker: man
intimidate.text: You need to be careful how you talk to people out here.

intimidate.speaker: man
intimidate.text: Say that again. Go ahead. Say it again.

intimidate.speaker: man
intimidate.text: I'm being real nice right now. You don't want me not nice.

intimidate.speaker: man
intimidate.text: Nobody around, huh? Just me and you.

intimidate.speaker: man
intimidate.text: You hear me talking to you? Don't disrespect me.
intimidate.thought: Agree with him. Just get away.

back_off.speaker: man
back_off.text: Alright. Whatever. Have a good night.

back_off.speaker: man
back_off.text: Forget it. You're not worth the trouble.

back_off.speaker: man

back_off.speaker: man
back_off.text: Yeah, go on home. Nobody's stopping you.
back_off.thought: Is that it? Is it over?

escalate.speaker: man

escalate.speaker: man
escalate.text: I said I'm talking to you!

escalate.speaker: man
escalate.text: You don't walk away from me!

b_man_thrown.speaker: man
b_man_thrown.text: Uh... what? No, I don't know, man.

b_man_thrown.speaker: man
b_man_thrown.text: You two know each other? Alright. Whatever.

b_man_thrown.speaker: man
b_man_thrown.text: I was just talking to her. It's all good.
b_man_thrown.thought: Stay next to them. Don't leave.

b_man_thrown.speaker: man
b_man_thrown.text: Okay, okay. I see how it is. Have a good night.
b_man_thrown.thought: He's stepping back. He's stepping back.

b_man_thrown.speaker: man
b_man_thrown.thought: Don't say anything. Let him go.

b_man_thrown.speaker: man
b_man_thrown.text: Alright then. Take care of your friend.
b_man_thrown.thought: Friend. Yes. I'm with my friend.

b_man_defensive_leave.speaker: man
b_man_defensive_leave.text: We just talking, man. Damn. Relax.

b_man_defensive_leave.speaker: man
b_man_defensive_leave.text: Nobody's bothering her. Alright, I'm going.
b_man_defensive_leave.thought: Don't let him change his mind.

b_man_defensive_leave.speaker: man
b_man_defensive_leave.text: Relax, relax. It's not that serious.
b_man_defensive_leave.thought: He's backing up. Keep him backing up.

b_man_defensive_leave.speaker: man
b_man_defensive_leave.text: Whatever, man. She's not even worth it.
b_man_defensive_leave.thought: Fine. Say what you want. Just go.

b_man_defensive_leave.speaker: man
b_man_defensive_leave.text: Okay, hero. You got it. I'm gone.
b_man_defensive_leave.thought: Please just let that be it.

b_man_defensive_leave.speaker: man

b_man_dismiss.speaker: man
b_man_dismiss.text: Hey, mind your business. We're talking.
b_man_dismiss.thought: No. Don't leave. Please don't leave.

b_man_dismiss.speaker: man
b_man_dismiss.text: This is between me and her, pal.
b_man_dismiss.thought: It isn't. Tell him it isn't.

b_man_dismiss.speaker: man
b_man_dismiss.text: We're good here. Go on about your night.

b_man_dismiss.speaker: man
b_man_dismiss.text: She's fine. Aren't you fine, sweetheart?
b_man_dismiss.thought: Say no. Why can't I say no?

b_man_dismiss.speaker: man
b_man_dismiss.text: Man, walk away. Nobody's talking to you.

b_man_turn.speaker: man
b_man_turn.text: The fuck are you? Her bodyguard?
b_man_turn.thought: Now he's angry at them. Move.

b_man_turn.speaker: man
b_man_turn.text: You got something to say to me? Say it to my face.
b_man_turn.thought: Go. Go while he's not looking.

b_man_turn.speaker: man
b_man_turn.text: Who asked you? Mind your fucking business.
b_man_turn.thought: Don't get hurt because of me.

b_man_turn.speaker: man
b_man_turn.text: Oh, you a tough guy now? Come here.

b_man_turn.speaker: man
b_man_turn.text: You wanna play hero? Step up, then.
b_man_turn.thought: Please don't let him hit them.

b_man_turn.speaker: man
b_man_turn.text: What'd you say to me? No, say it again.

b_man_squareup.speaker: man
b_man_squareup.text: You don't know me. You don't know what I'll do.
b_man_squareup.thought: Neither do I. That's the problem.

b_man_squareup.speaker: man
b_man_squareup.text: Keep running your mouth. See what happens.

b_man_squareup.speaker: man
b_man_squareup.text: I'm right here. What are you gonna do?
b_man_squareup.thought: Just walk away. Both of us.

b_man_squareup.speaker: man
b_man_squareup.text: You're real brave for somebody shaking.

b_man_squareup.speaker: man
b_man_squareup.text: Back up. I'm not gonna tell you twice.
b_man_squareup.thought: Back up. Do what he says.

b_man_bluster_leave.text: Man, fuck this. You two aren't worth it.

b_man_bluster_leave.speaker: man

b_man_bluster_leave.speaker: man

b_man_bluster_leave.speaker: man

b_woman_answer_ok.speaker: woman

b_woman_thanks.speaker: woman

b_woman_thanks.thought: I'm not alright. But I will be.

b_woman_thanks.speaker: woman

b_woman_thanks.thought: Just until I can't see him.

b_woman_thanks.speaker: woman
b_woman_thanks.text: I thought nobody was going to do anything.

b_woman_thanks.speaker: woman
b_woman_thanks.text: Thank you. I'm sorry. I'm shaking.

b_woman_leaving.speaker: woman

b_woman_leaving.speaker: woman
